sources.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
sources.actual_reading: Re-read cached original text lines 24-32: section 2 interaction formulation, actions/observations and flexible task actions; earlier abstract/introduction visible. Not a complete new review.
sources.use: Ground the allocation action in explicit allowed tools and available observations; keep actual decisions and tool outputs separate.
limitations: The paper benchmarks QA, fact verification, text games and web navigation, not dynamic UAV interference.
M4 uses one allocation call per state and does not reproduce the full interleaved ReAct algorithm.
Neither interpretability of a reason nor classical solver improvement establishes LLM decision benefit.
M4 priority formula and 40m/sqrt(2) limits are project choices, not paper guarantees.
